WITH sales_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        w_state,
        i_item_id,
        d_date,
        cs_sales_price,
        cr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_sales
    LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns
        ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number
       AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
    JOIN item
        ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
       AND i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
    JOIN warehouse
        ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim
        ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
       AND d_date BETWEEN cast('2001-04-02' AS date) AND cast('2001-06-01' AS date)
)
SELECT
    w_state,
    i_item_id,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN cast(d_date AS date) < cast('2001-05-02' AS date)
            THEN cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS sales_before,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN cast(d_date AS date) >= cast('2001-05-02' AS date)
            THEN cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS sales_after
FROM sales_rows
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
